build_mask_decoder: build a MaskDecoder instance with a transformer module and configurable multimask output count
run_mask_decoder_forward: run the MaskDecoder forward pass with image embeddings and prompt embeddings to predict masks
run_mask_decoder_predict_masks: run the MaskDecoder predict_masks method to get raw mask predictions and IOU scores
build_mlp: build an MLP module with configurable input hidden output dimensions and layer depth
review_mask_decoder_architecture: review the MaskDecoder output upscaling and hypernetwork layers for mask prediction
